boiling curve runs under saturated conditions at atmospheric pressure.

combinations

1462 kW m-2 was recorded at higher concentrations

Each run involved recording the boiling curves
up to the CHF, spanning a duration of 45 min.

0.2 μm.

164◦± 0.7◦was recorded on superhydrophobic surfaces before boiling tests, while after
exposure to boiling, a value of 140◦± 0.8◦was measured.

surface after boiling with 0.1 wt.% nanofluid was around 3◦
